name: - QTNToken
fix_description: In _transfer(), the rebase condition calculates newBalance = currentBalance + amount, but currentBalance already includes amount (since _tokenTransfer was called before). This double-counts amount in the condition check, making rebasePlus trigger more easily. Fix by computing currentBalance before _tokenTransfer, or use balanceOf(to) - amount as the pre-transfer balance.
difficulty_reasoning: The exploit is not a simple one-call bug: it requires understanding a fee-on-transfer/tokenomics flaw around Uniswap pair skimming, repeated deployment of helper contracts, timed waits to bypass the token’s last-buy restriction, and then unwinding back to WETH. While the PoC is fairly short, it is a multi-step, protocol-specific attack involving Uniswap pair mechanics and token transfer restrictions, placing it above easy.
